testCases.title: XSS Sanitization removes raw script tags

testCases.title: Invalid DD-MM-YYYY format rejected

testCases.title: JWT generation creates valid 3-part dot-separated token
testCases.preconditions: Valid user payload, 256-bit secret, and TTL provided

testCases.title: JWT signature verification extracts subject ('sub') claim

steps: Decode token and match subject claim against user ID

testCases.title: JWT verification extracts authenticated user email claim
steps: Inspect decoded claims array for email key

testCases.title: JWT timestamps integrity (iat <= now and exp > now)
steps: Verify iat <= time() and exp > time()
testCases.expected: exp timestamp in future, valid 1hr window

testCases.title: JWT rejects tampered cryptographic signature with exception
testCases.preconditions: Attacker appends 'tamper' string to valid token signature
steps: Call JwtHelper::verify() with manipulated token string
testCases.assertion: RuntimeException caught due to signature mismatch

testCases.title: JWT rejects expired token with exception
testCases.preconditions: Token generated with negative TTL (-10 seconds)
testCases.assertion: RuntimeException caught due to token expiration

testCases.title: Bcrypt password hashing format compliance ($2y$ with cost 12)

testCases.title: password_verify strictly rejects wrong password
